name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Arena v2 step 6 remains inactive until the first verified hit on the exact spawned raid boss. The boss's live position becomes the arena center. Players already within 2200 units remain completely untouched; only more distant players are moved to a 1200-unit entry ring with a safe Z lift above both their current height and the boss height to avoid terrain embedding. The enlarged BP_LevelObject_TowerLockBarrier_C appears after a short delay at 5.0x horizontal / 2.2x vertical scale with replicated bLocked=true. Because the TowerLockBarrier blueprint internally switches ECollisionEnabled from its lock state, BarrierMesh and BP_InteractableBox are explicitly neutralized to NoCollision after locking, followed by actor-level collision disable. The 3000-unit server keep-in is the authoritative boundary. No custom RPC, Niagara call or AI mutation is used. No client installation required.
